import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long mod = 1000000009;
    static long INF = mod * mod;
    static long mod_pow(long x, long n, long m) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if (n % 2 == 1)res = (res * x) % m;
            x = (x * x) % m; n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    static class modint {
        long n;
        modint() { n = 0; }
        modint(long m) { n = m; if (n >= mod)n %= mod; else if (n < 0)n = (n % mod + mod) % mod; }
        long toInt() { return n; }
    }
    static boolean operator_eq(modint a, modint b) { return a.n == b.n; }
    static modint operator_plus_eq(modint a, modint b) { a.n += b.n; if (a.n >= mod)a.n -= mod; return a; }
    static modint operator_minus_eq(modint a, modint b) { a.n -= b.n; if (a.n < 0)a.n += mod; return a; }
    static modint operator_times_eq(modint a, modint b) { a.n = ((long)a.n * b.n) % mod; return a; }
    static modint operator_plus(modint a, modint b) { return operator_plus_eq(a, b); }
    static modint operator_minus(modint a, modint b) { return operator_minus_eq(a, b); }
    static modint operator_times(modint a, modint b) { return operator_times_eq(a, b); }
    static modint operator_divide(modint a, modint b) { return a * new modint(1) / b; }
    static modint operator_pow(modint a, long n) {
        if (n == 0)return new modint(1);
        modint res = (a * a) % mod; if (n % 2 == 1)res = res * a;
        return res;
    }
    static long inv(long a, long p) {
        return (a == 1 ? 1 : (1 - p * inv(p % a, a)) / a + p);
    }
    static modint operator_divide_eq(modint a, modint b) { return a * new modint(inv(b.n, mod)); }
    static class mP {
        modint first, second;
        mP(modint first, modint second) { this.first = first; this.second = second; }
        mP mul(mP a, mP b) { return new mP(a.first * b.first, a.second * b.first + a.first * b.second); }
        mP plu(mP a, mP b) { return new mP(a.first + b.first, a.second + b.second); }
    }
    static mP dp[] = new mP[501];
    static boolean used[] = new boolean[501];
    static void init() {
        dp[0] = new mP(new modint(1), new modint(0));
        dp[1] = new mP(new modint(2), new modint(0));
        for (int n = 2; n <= 500; n++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                modint cnt = n + 1; modint sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++)sum += Math.abs(j - k);
                mP cl = dp[j]; mP cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
                mP x = cl.mul(cr);
                x.first *= comb(n - 1, j);
                x.second *= comb(n - 1, j);
                x = x.mul(new mP(cnt, sum));
                dp[n] = dp[n].plu(x);
            }
        }
    }
    static long comb(int a, int b) {
        if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a < b)return 0;
        modint fact[] = new modint[501];
        modint factinv[] = new modint[501];
        fact[0] = new modint(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 500; i++)fact[i + 1] = fact[i].times(new modint(i + 1));
        factinv[500] = new modint(1) / fact[500];
        for (int i = 499; i >= 0; i--)factinv[i] = factinv[i + 1].times(new modint(i + 1));
        return fact[a].toInt() * factinv[b].toInt() * factinv[a - b].toInt();
    }
    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        init();
        mP dp2[][] = new mP[502][501];
        dp2[0][0] = new mP(new modint(1), new modint(0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    int ni = j + 2; ni = Math.min(ni, n);
                    int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                    if (nk <= m) {
                        mP x = dp2[i][k].mul(dp[j - i + 1]);
                        x.first *= comb(nk, k);
                        x.second *= comb(nk, k);
                        dp2[ni][nk] = dp2[ni][nk].plu(x);
                    }
                }
                dp2[i + 1][k] = dp2[i + 1][k].plu(dp2[i][k]);
            }
        }
        modint ans = dp2[n][m].second;
        pw.println(ans.toLong());
        pw.close();
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }
}
